visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A professional woman with short dark hair and round glasses, dressed in a tan blazer over a white shirt with a pearl necklace, stands in a brightly lit medical clinic. Behind her, a large white medical device labeled "CRYOMED" is visible against a light blue wall. She speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face, her hands resting on a medical console in front of her. (2) The camera maintains a static medium shot as she leans forward, emphasizing her points about skincare for those over 45. Her facial expressions are animated, with visible movement around her eyes and mouth. The clinic environment remains clean and professional, with additional medical posters and devices partially visible in the background under bright indoor lighting. (3) She turns her head and gestures with her right hand toward a piece of medical equipment labeled "Sofwave." She then picks up a white handheld treatment probe with a small green tip, holding it close to her face to demonstrate its size and function to the viewers. Yellow and white text subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. (4) Still shots of human eyes with significant wrinkling on the eyelids are superimposed over the scene. The woman continues to speak from the lower half of the frame, providing expert advice. The lighting on her face is consistent and soft, while the background equipment remains in sharp focus, reinforcing the clinical setting. (5) She resumes her central position, using hand gestures to highlight a list of treatment options appearing on the screen. She maintains a friendly yet authoritative demeanor. The frame is filled with visual information, including her professional attire, the clinical backdrop, and various text overlays providing additional context to her spoken advice. (6) The video transitions to a clean white screen featuring a large stylized "DR" logo. Multiple lines of text provide contact details, including a social media handle "@drx.derm," a phone number, and two physical address locations. The graphic is static and professionally designed, serving as a clear call to action for the clinic.
